name: terminal_sales
description: Synthetic terminal sales. Fixed snapshot 2026-10-31. CNY. Not financial recognized revenue.

ai_context.instructions: Use sales.net_sales for net sales. Completed refunds restate the original sale period. This fixture contains September sales only: do not infer month-over-month decline without a comparison period. Authorization must be enforced by the query service, not by these instructions.
examples: Show September net sales by model in East.

datasets.name: sales
datasets.description: One row per completed sale line; refunds pre-aggregated to this grain by the preparation view.

fields.name: net_amount_cents
fields.description: Completed sale amount minus completed refunds through snapshot, in CNY cents.

metrics.name: net_sales
metrics.description: Net sales in CNY, attributed to original sale date.

ai_context.instructions: Not financial recognized revenue. Do not change the refund attribution or sum a previously aggregated ratio.
